result.instructions: Tools for LoyJoy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which agents are in my LoyJoy tenant, and which of them are published?"; "Search my LoyJoy knowledge for the opening hours and tell me what it says."; "Create a knowledge article in the 'FAQ' catalog about our returns policy.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes LoyJoy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run loyjoy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run loyjoy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run loyjoy_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. loyjoy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: loyjoy_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List all agents (LoyJoy processes) of the tenant with id, name, folder and state. Roles: owner, editor, processes_editor or processes_viewer.

tools.name: loyjoy_get_agent
tools.title: Get agent
tools.description: Get one agent (process) by id: its id and name, read from the latest saved (staging) version. Roles: owner, editor, processes_editor or processes_viewer.

agent_id.description: Id as returned by a list tool.

tools.name: loyjoy_start_agent
tools.title: Start agent
tools.description: Start the published version of an agent with optional variables, and return the resulting variables. The agent halts when it expects user input, for example at a Proceed module. Roles: owner or editor.

agent_id.description: Id as returned by a list tool.

tools.name: loyjoy_ask_agent
tools.title: Ask agent
tools.description: Send one user message to the published (production) agent in a new single-use conversation, and return its answer. Roles: owner or editor.

agent_id.description: Id as returned by a list tool.

locale.description: Locale, for example de or en. The API default is de.

tools.name: loyjoy_list_home_views
tools.title: List home views
tools.description: List all home views of the tenant with id and name. Roles: owner, editor, processes_editor or processes_viewer.

tools.name: loyjoy_get_home_view
tools.title: Get home view
tools.description: Get one home view by id, with its id and name. Roles: owner, editor, processes_editor or processes_viewer.

view_id.description: Id as returned by a list tool.

tools.name: loyjoy_list_catalogs
tools.title: List knowledge catalogs
tools.description: List all knowledge catalogs of the tenant with id, name and updated_at. Roles: owner, editor, knowledge_editor, knowledge_exporter or knowledge_viewer.

tools.name: loyjoy_get_catalog
tools.title: Get knowledge catalog
tools.description: Get one knowledge catalog by id: its metadata only. Its articles come from loyjoy_list_articles. Roles: owner, editor, knowledge_editor, knowledge_exporter or knowledge_viewer.

tools.name: loyjoy_list_articles
tools.title: List articles
tools.description: List all articles of one knowledge catalog. Roles: owner, editor, knowledge_editor, knowledge_exporter or knowledge_viewer.

tools.name: loyjoy_get_article
tools.title: Get article
tools.description: Get one article of a knowledge catalog by id. Roles: owner, editor, knowledge_editor, knowledge_exporter or knowledge_viewer.

article_id.description: Id as returned by a list tool.

tools.name: loyjoy_list_knowledge_sources
tools.title: List knowledge sources
tools.description: List all knowledge sources of the tenant, URL and upload kinds, with their folder, type and last indexing time. Roles: owner, editor, knowledge_editor, knowledge_exporter or knowledge_viewer.

tools.name: loyjoy_search_knowledge
tools.title: Search knowledge
tools.description: Search the knowledge chunks of the tenant for a query. Returns up to max_chunks chunks (1 to 100, default 100). The root folder is always searched; subfolders only when listed in folders. Roles: owner, editor, knowledge_editor, knowledge_exporter or knowledge_viewer.

tools.name: loyjoy_create_catalog
tools.title: Create knowledge catalog
tools.description: Create a new, empty knowledge catalog with the given name. Each call creates another catalog. Roles: owner, editor or knowledge_editor.

tools.name: loyjoy_create_article
tools.title: Create article
tools.description: Create an article in a knowledge catalog, in one locale. Writes are limited to one per second per catalog: a faster write returns HTTP 500, so wait about one second between writes to the same catalog. Roles: owner, editor or knowledge_editor.

title.description: The article title, in the given locale.

text.description: The article body, in the given locale.

locale.description: Locale, for example de or en. The API default is de.

source_url.description: Optional source URL of the article.

search_disable.description: Set true to keep the article out of search results.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with LoyJoy
prompts.description: What you can do with LoyJoy here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_the_agents_and_home_views_of_a_tenant
prompts.title: Review the agents and home views of a tenant
prompts.description: List the agents with their state and folder, then open one agent or home view to read its name and id.

prompts.name: find_what_the_knowledge_base_says
prompts.title: Find what the knowledge base says
prompts.description: Search the knowledge chunks for a question, or browse a catalog's articles and sources to see what the agents can answer from.

prompts.name: add_an_article_to_a_knowledge_catalog
prompts.title: Add an article to a knowledge catalog
prompts.description: Create a catalog if needed, then add an article in one locale. Writes are limited to one per second per catalog.

prompts.name: test_a_published_agent
prompts.title: Test a published agent
prompts.description: Send one message to the published agent, or start it with variables and read the variables it returns.
